objects.description: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) Spider enumerates a target organization for files and directories of interest, including source code, user provisioning, MFA device registration, network diagrams, and shared credentials in documents or spreadsheets.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)
objects.description_fa: [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) Spider یک سازمان هدف را برای فایل ها و فهرست های مورد علاقه، از جمله کد منبع، تهیه کاربر، ثبت دستگاه MFA، نمودارهای شبکه، و اعتبارنامه های مشترک در اسناد یا صفحات گسترده.(Citation: CISA Scattered Spider Advisory November 2023)(Citation: MSTIC Octo Tempest Operations October 2023)(Citation: Mandiant UNC3944 May 2025)(Citation: CrowdStrike Scattered Spider JUL 2025)(Citation: Mandiant VMware vSphere JUL 2025)
